# Safe Shell Composer

## Core idea
When generating multi-line text through shells, quoting and heredocs are failure-prone. Prefer editor-grade file writes for content with `$`, backticks, regex metacharacters, or non-ASCII text.

## Practice
If a shell write path once corrupted content, switch mechanisms on the next attempt—do not repeat the same quoting hazard.

## Anti-patterns
Assuming heredocs preserve literals; debugging invisible truncation instead of changing the write path.
